state.goal: Read every file in /legacy (index.html, styles.css, script.js, recipelookup.js, search.js, darkmode.js, the full contents of recipes/, site.webmanifest, and the favicon/fallback assets). Produce a written inventory describing: what each script does, what DOM elements/IDs/classes they depend on, what data format recipes/ actually contains, and how the files reference each other. Make no code changes.
plan: Based on my review of all files in /legacy, here is the numbered implementation plan:

1. Document **index.html** structure: main page markup with menu system (#myNav), search input (#search), recipe list (#recipes), buttons (#toggleDark, #randomRecipe), and overlay menu (.overlay-menu, .overlay-content)
2. Document **script.js** functionality: Firebase initialization, recipe list loading from Firestore, sorting recipes alphabetically, search filtering, menu toggle logic (toggleMenu function)
3. Document **script.js** DOM dependencies: elements #recipes, #search, #myNav, .menu-icon, .overlay-content, #recipeMenu, with event listeners on search input and toggleMenu

4. Document **recipelookup.js** functionality: loads individual recipe from Firebase by URL pathname, renders title/info/ingredients/instructions into HTML elements, handles image fallback (png → jpg → jpeg), manages recipe detail page display
5. Document **recipelookup.js** DOM dependencies: elements #header, #info, #ingredients, #instructions, #image with pre-formatted content rendering
6. Document **search.js** functionality: recipe list initialization, search/filter by name, "random recipe" feature, sorting/tag filtering system with recipe.tags property (comma-separated values)

7. Document **search.js** DOM dependencies: elements #recipes, #search, #randomRecipe, #recipeMenu, sort buttons (.sortButtons), dropdown (#myDropdown), with state tracking via sortStates and sortTags objects
8. Document **darkmode.js** functionality: toggles dark-mode CSS class on body, persists preference to localStorage, updates button text between "Tumma tila"/"Vaalea tila" (Finnish: Dark/Light mode)
9. Document **darkmode.js** DOM dependencies: element #toggleDark button, body element for class toggling, localStorage for state persistence

10. Document **styles.css** color scheme: light mode (white background, black text), dark mode (#121212 background, white text), layout uses flexbox/grid for recipe details, responsive design with mobile breakpoint at 768px

11. Document **recipe data format**: Firebase Firestore collection structure with recipe documents containing fields: title (string), ingredients (multiline text), instructions (multiline text), info (description text), tags (comma-separated values like "main,kana,kastike")

12. Document **recipes/ directory structure**: contains recipe-template.html (template for recipe detail pages) and img/ subfolder (recipe images indexed by recipe document ID with .png/.jpg/.jpeg extensions)

13. Document **file interconnections**: index.html loads script.js + darkmode.js; script.js and search.js both fetch from Firestore and populate #recipes/#recipeMenu; recipelookup.js loads from URL pathname to display recipe details; darkmode.js attaches to #toggleDark button; all use styles.css
14. Document **site.webmanifest** structure: PWA manifest with app name/icons (android-chrome-192x192.png, android-chrome-512x512.png) and display mode "standalone"
15. Document **favicon assets**: favicon.ico, favicon-16x16.png, favicon-32x32.png, apple-touch-icon.png, fallback.png for PWA/browser icon support (referenced in index.html head)
